messages:
Harpreet Singh: Hi folks  coordinating onsite logistics for candidate Mei L. visiting from Toronto on Mon Aug 12. Candidate needs clarity on visa-related hiring timeline and whether we can reimburse cross-border travel. Also requests a tracked translator for first-round interview (English ok but prefers tech terms clarified).

Leda (Recruiter): Mei has a TN-in-progress; work-authorized status uncertain until September. Shed like to know if offer timing can align with permit issuance. Also asks about currency for stipend  prefers CAD.

Ana (People Ops): For reimbursement: we process all hire travel in USD via ACH. We can convert via current FX rate on payment date. We cannot pay CAD directly. Candidate can submit CAD receipts and we will reimburse in USD. Expense code: EXP-HIRE-INTL-2025.

Legal: For TN timing, please send Meis filing timeline and we can advise on required start-date windows. We can also prep a standard contingent-offer clause referencing work authorization. I'll follow up via email.

Harpreet Singh: Noted. Leda, can you ask Mei to send filing ETA and any proof docs? We'll tentatively schedule interviews but mark them as "virtual fallback" if paperwork delayed.

Leda (Recruiter): Will do. Also, Mei asked about translator costs. Is that an approved expense?

Ana (People Ops): Yes  translator fees for candidate accommodations are covered. Use EXP-ACCESS-ACC. Please attach invoice or receipt. We prefer vendor invoice to personal payments.

People Ops Bot: Badge request queued  BR-11002. Note: for international visitors, HR needs passport copy 48h before visit.

Harpreet Singh: Calendar note: schedule hybrid day Aug 12, start 9:30 PT, Room 312 booked. Add "virtual fallback" Zoom link and translator phone contact.

Leda (Recruiter): Mei will confirm travel and translator vendor by EOD tomorrow. I'll include guidance on ACH reimbursement (USD) and attach legal note about contingent offer.

Ana (People Ops): Action items: (1) Recruiter collect filing ETA + passport copy 48h prior (2) Legal draft contingent-offer clause (3) Ops confirm translator vendor billing details (4) Payroll prep ACH instructions for international remit. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

Harpreet Singh: :white_check_mark:

Leda (Recruiter): :white_check_mark:
